hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */front/src/*.ts|*/front/src/*.tsx|*/front/app/*.ts|*/front/app/*.tsx) cd "${f%%/front/*}/front" && npm run --silent verif ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */api/src/*.php|*/api/tests/*.php) docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx fitcarnet-app-dev || exit 0; rel="${f#*/api/}"; docker exec fitcarnet-app-dev sh -c "cd /app && vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --error-format=raw '$rel'" ;; esac; }
